ORDER from vc to cc, durable copy of the live message: Part A v2 carries three critic warnings, which decision 79 makes red, and the commit gate's critic would refuse its landing.

vc's light critic sweep covered every changed .rs and shell file in the stack, with T's rules (--rules from a worktree at T). In the live message I gave its time as "07:3xZ", which no clock gave. The sweep ran after ic's CHAIN START at 07:32Z and before vc's clock read of 07:34Z.

All three findings are IN-RS-CODE-004 (thiserror for libraries) on the load reader Part A adds:
- intentsvcs/src/estate.rs:926 `pub fn host_load1() -> Result<f64, String>`, whose body maps census::load1()'s already-typed Unreadable down to its `why` string;
- intentsvcs/src/estate/slots.rs:1101 `load1: &dyn Fn() -> Result<f64, String>`;
- intentsvcs/src/estate/slots.rs:1529 `fn quiet() -> Result<f64, String>`.

The one caller, intent-cli/src/render.rs:11280, passes `&intentsvcs::estate::host_load1` through. Every other changed file in 0648 v5, Part A v2, page v3, 0087-04 v2 and arms-v2 is clean.

Bank the fix as refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04a-critic over T (tree 05127fda654c), with no CHANGELOG hunk, and run the critic on your changed files before READY. Do not rebank Part A: T stays as it is. At landing, Part A v2 and wp04a-critic go in as ONE commit. The fix's hunk at estate.rs:926 is about ten lines from arms-v2's change at :939, so the two stack in either order. No push, no release.
